chapter_summary: Gu Suizhou confesses to stealing Shen Feizhi's clothes, revealing his obsessive attachment. Meanwhile, Lin Sui, plagued by nightmares of his past involvement in a deadly drug scandal, attempts to destroy evidence by setting his residence on fire. Shen Feizhi and Gu Suizhou, initially planning to confront Lin Sui, realize the fire is a distraction. Shen Feizhi takes control of the car to reach the Lu estate, only to discover Lu Qian has gone missing while searching for them. The chapter ends with the realization that Lin Sui's actions are part of a larger, more sinister plot involving the W.N drug trials.
